blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Pre-pretraining (PPT) on synthetic non-natural language data improves token efficiency during language model pre-training (PT).
Prior work attributes this gain to a grammatical prior, i.e., a structural inductive bias learned during PPT that transfers to natural language grammar.
However, PPT has only been tested on models of at most 1B parameters and PT budgets below 2B tokens on predominantly web text. It is unknown whether PPT is effective at larger scales and under more realistic PT data mixtures that combine diverse sources (e.g., code and math).
We therefore present a comprehensive study on PPT spanning five PPT tasks, four PT data mixtures, four parameter scales (500M to 7B), and PT budgets of up to 100B tokens.
Our results demonstrate that the downstream performance and token efficiency gains of PPT persist at scale, e.g., saving at least 21B PT tokens at the 3B scale.
However, in contrast to prior work, we find no consistent evidence that these gains stem from a grammatical prior.
Downstream performance does not consistently align with grammatical acceptability across model sizes.
Instead, we find that downstream gains arise from PPT tasks that improve long-range retrieval.
Finally, PPT performance gains are robust to how PT data mixtures are composed and diminish only when web text is absent.
Overall, PPT is a low-cost addition to PT, and future PPT task design should target long-range retrieval rather than natural language grammar.
blocks.zh:
关于合成非自然语言数据的预训(PPT)在语言模型预训(PT)期间提高了符号效率.
先前的工作将这一收益归结为语法上的先导,即PPT期间所学到的结构诱导偏差,这种偏差转移至自然语言语法.
然而,PPT只在以网络文本为主的最多1B参数和低于2B符号的PT预算模型上进行了测试. 目前尚不清楚PPT在更大尺度上是否有效,在结合不同来源(如代码和数学)的更现实的PT数据混合物下是否有效.
因此,我们提出了一项关于PPT的综合研究,涉及五个PPT任务、四个PT数据混合物、四个参数尺度(500M至7B)和最多100B符号的PT预算。
我们的结果表明,PPT的下游性能和象征性效率收益在规模上持续,例如,在3B尺度上至少节省了21B PT标志.
然而,与以前的工作不同,我们没有找到一致的证据,证明这些成果来自语法上的先。
下游性能与模型大小的语法可接受性不一致.
相反,我们发现,下游的收益来自改进远程检索的PPT任务。
最后,PPT的性能增益对于PT数据混合物的构成很强,只有在没有网络文本时才会减少.
总体而言,PPT是PT的低成本添加,未来的PPT任务设计应该针对远程检索而不是自然语言语法.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Pre-training (PT) equips language models (LMs) with general capabilities ( Gemma Team et al., 2026 ; Qwen Team, 2026 ; Kimi Team et al., 2026 , inter alia ) but is prohibitively expensive, often consuming tens of trillions of tokens ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) .
Recent studies ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 , inter alia ) show that pre-pretraining (PPT), a warm-up phase on synthetic non-natural language sequences such as k k -Shuffle Dyck (i.e., an interleaved balanced-parentheses language), improves token efficiency during subsequent PT on natural language data.
Previous work ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ) attributes this improvement to a grammatical prior , i.e., a structural inductive bias acquired from PPT data, which transfers to natural language (Figure 1 a).
blocks.zh:
预训(PT)为语言模型(LM)配备一般能力(Gemma Team等人,2026年;Quen Team,2026年;Kimi). Team et al., 2026年,等等),但价格昂贵令人望而却步,经常消耗数十万亿令牌(Hoffmann et al., 2022).
最近的研究(Hu 等人,2025年;Mita等人,2026年;Cheng等人,2026年等)表明,预训(PPT)是合成非自然语言序列如k k-Shuffle Dyck(即间叶平衡-亲本语言)的热身阶段,在之后的自然语言数据PT中提高了象征性的效率.
先前的著作(Hu等人,2025年;Mita等人,2026年)将这一改进归因于语法上的先验性,即从PPT数据中获得的结构诱导偏差,它转移至自然语言(图1a).

blocks.en:
The practical utility of PPT rests on one question that remains unanswered under more realistic conditions of larger model size, longer PT, and more diverse PT data: do the performance and token efficiency gains of PPT persist at scale? Prior studies on PPT cannot answer this question, because their experimental setups diverge from typical PT scenarios in three ways (Figure 1 b).
First, they experiment with models at or below 1B parameters ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) , whereas PT studies often operate at 2B parameters and above to draw conclusions ( Biderman et al., 2023 ; Penedo et al., 2023 ; Xue et al., 2026 ) . Hu et al. (2025) and Mita et al. (2026) leave the behavior of PPT beyond 1B parameters as an open question.
Second, they often stop PT early at less than 2B tokens ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 , inter alia ) , far short of the budgets used to validate PT design decisions in recent work ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Yamaguchi et al., 2026 , e.g., 100B tokens) .
This raises the possibility that observed gains stem from temporary initialization effects.
Such benefits may disappear as extended optimization shifts parameters away from the warm-up state ( Ji & Telgarsky, 2020 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) .
Third, they rely on single-domain PT corpora, e.g., C4 ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) , that are dominated by or entirely derived from web text ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ) .
Modern PT instead employs curated mixtures containing code and mathematics data ( Bakouch et al., 2025 ; Martins et al., 2025 ; Team Olmo et al., 2026 ) .
Because code and mathematics contain nested dependencies and strict structural rules, these domains may supply structural signals similar to those from PPT, potentially rendering it redundant.
blocks.zh:
PPT的实际效用在于一个在更大的模型规模、更长的PT和更加多样化的PT数据等更现实的条件下仍未解答的问题:PPT的性能和象征性的效率收益是否在规模上继续存在? 以前关于PPT的研究无法回答这个问题,因为他们的实验设置在三个方面不同于典型的PT情景(图1b).
首先,它们试验1B参数或以下的模型(Hu等人,2025年;Mita等人,2026年;Jiang等人,2026年;Guo等人,2026年;Cheng等人,2026年),而PT研究往往在2B参数及以上进行,以得出结论(Biderman等人,2023年;Penedo等人,2023年;Xue等人,2026年)。 Hu et al. (2025)和Mita et al. (2026) 将PPT的行为超出1B参数留作待决问题.
其次,他们往往早早以低于2B令牌(Hu等人,2025年;Mita等人,2026年等)停止PT,远低于近期工作中用于验证PT设计决定的预算(Cheng等人,2024年;Ye等人,2025年;山口等人,2026年,例如100B令牌).
这就产生了一种可能性,即观察到的收益来自临时初始化效应。
随着延伸优化参数脱离暖化状态,这些好处可能会消失(Ji & Telgarsky,2020年;Liu等人,2023年)。
第三,它们依赖于单一域的PT corpora,例如C4(Raffel等人,2020年),它们以网络文本为主或完全来自网络文本(Hu等人,2025年;Mita等人,2026年).
现代PT转而采用含有代码和数学数据的配方混合物(Bakouch等人,2025年;Martins等人,2025年;Team Olmo等人,2026年)。
由于代码和数学中包含嵌套依赖和严格的结构规则,这些域可能提供类似于PPT的结构信号,有可能使其变得多余.

blocks.en: Figure 1: (a) PPT is claimed to induce a grammatical prior that transfers to natural language. (b) Prior work sits at or below 1B parameters and short training horizons. We span four scales, four PT mixtures, five PPT tasks, and up to 100B PT tokens.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we systematically evaluate PPT across four parameter scales (500M, 1B, 3B, and 7B) under a default PT budget of 21B tokens and an extended budget reaching 100B tokens, i.e., up to around 50 × \times more than previous work.
We test four publicly available PT data mixtures with documented composition: web text (C4); a web-dominant mixture (Marin 1 1 1 https://marin.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reports/marin-8b-retro/ ); a filtered-web mixture with balanced code and mathematics (SmolLM3 ( Bakouch et al., 2025 ) ); and a STEM-weighted mixture (OLMo3 ( Team Olmo et al., 2026 ) ).
We also compare five PPT tasks: two formal languages; two structured synthetic tasks lacking formal grammars; and an in-domain text control that samples PPT data from the PT corpus.
We evaluate each model on linguistic competence via BLiMP ( Warstadt et al., 2020 ) for grammatical acceptability and verbatim retrieval ( Armeni et al., 2022 ; Armeni et al., 2024 ) for long-range retrieval capability.
Furthermore, we test general capability across ten benchmarks spanning reading comprehension, science question answering (QA), commonsense reasoning, and language modeling.

我们测试了四种公开提供的PT数据混合物的成份:网络文本(C4);网络支配混合物(Marin 1 1 1 1 https://marin.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reports/marin-8b-retro/);具有平衡代码和数学的过滤网混合物(SmolLM3(Bakouch等人,2025年);STEM加权混合物(OLMo3(Team Olmo等人,2026年))。
我们还比较了五个PPT任务:两个正式语言;两个结构化的合成任务缺乏正式语法;以及一个域内文本控制,从PPT程序表中对PPT数据进行样本.
我们通过BLIMP(Warstadt等人,2020年)来评价语言能力方面的每个模型,以便进行语法上的可接受性和逐字记录(Armeni等人,2022年;Armeni等人,2024年),以便进行远距离检索。
此外,我们通过阅读理解、科学问题回答(QA)、常识推理和语言建模等10个基准测试一般能力。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Synthetic Pre-pretraining
blocks.zh: 2.1 预科培训

blocks.en:
Early work has explored structural transfer by pre-training LSTMs ( Hochreiter & Schmidhuber, 1997 ) and Transformers ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) on artificial languages or non-linguistic sequences, including music ( Papadimitriou & Jurafsky, 2020 ) and artificial formal grammars ( Papadimitriou & Jurafsky, 2020 ; Ri & Tsuruoka, 2022 ; Papadimitriou & Jurafsky, 2023 ) , prior to fine-tuning or evaluating them on natural language tasks.
In modern decoder-only LMs, PPT is a warm-up training phase on synthetic sequences before PT on natural language data, consisting of three steps.
First, a generator produces a synthetic corpus, typically from a formal language such as k k -Shuffle Dyck ( Hu et al., 2025 ) .
Second, a randomly initialized model trains on the generated corpus for a budget far smaller than the subsequent PT run.
Third, the resulting parameters initialize PT, either transferred in full ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ) or with the embedding matrix and LM head re-initialized for the natural language tokenizer ( Cheng et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
早期工作通过预训LSTMs(Hohreiter & Schmidhuber,1997年)和变形金刚(Vaswani等人,2017年)探索了包括音乐(Papadimitriou & Jurafsky,2020年)和人工正式语法(Papadimitriou & Jurafsky,2020年;Ri & Tsuruoka,2022年;Papadimitriou & Jurafsky,2023年)在内的人工语言或非语言序列的结构转移,然后对自然语言任务进行微调或评价.
在现代解码器唯LMs中,PPT是自然语言数据PT前合成序列的热解训练阶段,由三个步骤组成.
首先,一个生成器会产生合成体,一般来自kk-Shuffle Dyck(Hu等人,2025年)等正式语言.
第二,随机初始化的型号列车在生成的元件上的预算远小于之后的PT运行.
第三,由此产生的参数初始化了PT, 要么完全转移(Hu等人,2025年;Mita等人,2026年),要么重新初始化自然语言代言器的嵌入基质和LM头(Cheng等人,2026年;Lee等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
Prior work on PPT differs mainly in what underlying structure the synthetic corpus encodes. Hu et al. (2025) argue that an effective corpus should capture hierarchical dependencies while remaining learnable by a Transformer. They instantiate this with k k -Shuffle Dyck, a context-sensitive bracket language to generate synthetic PPT data. Mita et al. (2026) claim that bracket matching in k k -Shuffle Dyck lacks cues to which opening bracket a closing one resolves. To tackle this issue, they propose adding agreement and displacement to the bracketed structure.
Beyond formal grammars, PPT has expanded to algorithmic tasks ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , formal logical derivations ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) , state trajectories of neural cellular automata ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , and synthetic recurrent structures ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , with recent extensions reaching vision models ( Shinnick et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
以往关于PPT的工作主要在合成物编码的基本结构上有所不同。 胡等人(2025年)认为,有效的文书应该捕捉等级依赖性,同时仍可被变形人学习. 他们用 kk -Shuffle Dyck 即时化它,一种对上下文敏感的括号语言,生成合成的PPT数据. Mita等人(2026年)声称,k-Shuffle Dyck中的括号没有提示打开括号即可解决。 为了解决这一问题,他们建议在括号内的结构中增加协议和流离失所。
除了正式语法, PPT 扩展为算法任务( Jiang et al., 2026), 正式逻辑衍生 (Cheng等人, 2026年),神经细胞自体的状态轨迹(Lee等人, 2026年),合成复发结构(Guo等人, 2026年),最近的扩展达到视觉模型(Shinnick等人, 2026年).

blocks.en: 2.2 Interplay between Pre-pretraining and Pre-training
blocks.zh: 2.2 预训与预训之间的相互交流

blocks.en:
Hu et al. (2025) attribute PPT effectiveness to a grammatical prior.
Models acquire structural priors independently of natural language vocabulary or world knowledge, and these priors transfer to natural language grammar ( Papadimitriou & Jurafsky, 2020 ; Ri & Tsuruoka, 2022 ; Papadimitriou & Jurafsky, 2023 ) .
However, this explanation has been tested only on predominantly web-text data, leaving unexamined how PPT interacts with PT data mixtures that combine more diverse sources, e.g., code and mathematics.
Such PT mixtures may induce structural abstractions ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Petty et al., 2025 ) , making PPT unnecessary.
blocks.zh:
胡等编著. (2025)将PPT的有效性归属于语法前.
模型独立于自然语言词汇或世界知识而获得结构前科,这些前科转移至自然语言语法(Papadimitriou & Jurafsky,2020年;Ri & Turuoka,2022年;Papadimitriou & Jurafsky,2023年).
然而,这一解释仅通过以网络文本数据为主的测试,使得PPT如何与PT数据混合物相互作用,这些混合物结合了比较多样化的来源,例如代码和数学.
这种PT混合物可能诱发结构抽象(Kim等人,2024年;Petty等人,2025年),使得PPT没有必要.

blocks.en: 2.3 Scale, Optimization Dynamics, and Warm-up Retention
blocks.zh: 2.3 规模、优化动态和温暖保留

blocks.en:
Three conditions related to the experimental settings used in PPT challenge the generalizability of earlier findings.
First, prior evaluations generally operate at or below the 1B parameter scale ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Budnikov & Yamshchikov, 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) .
Larger Transformers, however, can internalize hierarchical abstractions through standard training objectives alone ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Allen-Zhu & Li, 2025 ) .
Therefore, larger model capacity may already supply what synthetic PPT provides.
Second, previous studies rely on small batch sizes (e.g., 32) in both PPT and PT ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) , introducing higher stochastic gradient noise than large-batch setups ( McCandlish et al., 2018 ; Smith et al., 2018 ) .
In such noisy regimes, reported advantages may reflect initialization variance rather than a durable bias.
Third, existing work often stops PT early ( ≤ \leq 2B tokens) ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Budnikov & Yamshchikov, 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) , whereas extended optimization may dilute initialization biases that persist in under-trained models ( Ji & Telgarsky, 2020 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
与PPT中使用的实验设置相关的三个条件对早期发现的通用性提出了挑战.
一,前期评价一般运行在1B参数尺度或以下(Hu等人,2025年;Budnikov等人,2025年;Mita等人,2026年;Jiang等人,2026年;Guo等人,2026年;Cheng等人,2026年).
然而,更大的变形器可以单独通过标准培训目标(Liu等人,2023年;Allen-Zhu & Li,2025年)将等级抽象化。
因此,更大的模型能力可能已经提供合成PPT提供的东西.
其次,以往的研究都依赖于PPT和PT中的小批量尺寸(例如32个)(Hu等人,2025年;Mita等人,2026年;Guo等人,2026年),引入了比大批量设置更高的斜度噪声(McCandlish等人,2018年;Smith等人,2018年).
在这种吵闹的制度中,所报告的优点可能反映初始化的差异,而不是持久的偏见。
第三,现有工作往往早早停止PT(≤\leq 2B令牌)(Hu等人,2025年;Budnikov & Yamshchikov,2025年;Mita等人,2026年;Guo等人,2026年),而扩展优化可能会淡化在训练不足的模型中持续存在的初始化偏见(Ji & Telgarsky,2020年;Liu等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: 3 A Systematic Framework for Evaluating Pre-pretraining
blocks.zh: 3 预先培训评估的系统框架

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Setting
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题设置

blocks.en:
Let ℳ θ \mathcal{M}_{\theta} be an autoregressive LM with weights θ ∈ ℝ N \theta\in\mathbb{R}^{N} , where N N is the number of parameters, and let ℒ ( θ ; 𝒟 ) = 𝔼 x ∼ 𝒟 [ − ∑ t = 1 | x | log p θ ( x t ∣ x < t ) ] \mathcal{L}(\theta;\mathcal{D})=\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\mathcal{D}}\left[-\sum\nolimits_{t=1}^{|x|}\log p_{\theta}(x_{t}\mid x_{<t})\right] denote the negative log-likelihood (NLL) over a corpus 𝒟 \mathcal{D} .
Standard PT minimizes ℒ ⁡ ( θ , 𝒟 PT ) \mathcal{L}(\theta;\mathcal{D}_{\text{PT}}) from a random initialization θ 0 \theta_{0} , yielding θ PT \theta_{\text{PT}} ( PT-Only ).
PPT first minimizes ℒ ⁡ ( θ , 𝒟 PPT ) \mathcal{L}(\theta;\mathcal{D}_{\text{PPT}}) from the same θ 0 \theta_{0} over a much smaller dataset 𝒟 PPT \mathcal{D}_{\text{PPT}} where | 𝒟 PPT | ≪ | 𝒟 PT | |\mathcal{D}_{\text{PPT}}|\ll|\mathcal{D}_{\text{PT}}| , yielding θ PPT \theta_{\text{PPT}} .

blocks.en: To test whether the benefits of PPT generalize beyond small-scale settings, we evaluate performance across four dimensions: the PPT task (§ 3.2 ), PT data mixture (§ 3.3 ), parameter scale (§ 3.4 ), and PT budget (§ 3.5 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Pre-pretraining Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 预训前数据

blocks.en:
We evaluate five approaches for constructing 𝒟 PPT \mathcal{D}_{\text{PPT}} : two based on formal languages, two structured synthetic tasks without formal grammars, and an in-domain text control where we sample 𝒟 PPT \mathcal{D}_{\text{PPT}} data from 𝒟 PT \mathcal{D}_{\text{PT}} .
This allows us to test whether transfer requires a formal grammar or follows from structured sequences of any kind.
blocks.zh:
我们评价构建 DPT\ mathcal{D}_{\text{ PPT} 的五种方法:两种基于正式语言,两种结构化的合成任务没有正式的语法,以及一种域内文本控制,我们从 DPT\mathcal{D}_{\text{PPT}}数据中抽取 DPT{Mathcal{D}_{\text{PT}}} 。
这使得我们可以测试转移是需要正式的语法,还是从任何结构化的序列中遵循.

blocks.en:
k k -Shuffle Dyck ( Hu et al., 2025 ) is a context-sensitive language of interleaved bracket pairs (e.g., ( [ ( ] ) ) ).
As the foundational PPT task for which transfer to natural language grammar was reported, it serves as our primary synthetic task. MP-Struct Core ( Mita et al., 2026 ) places marker tokens beside each bracket pair (e.g., [0 H_C (4 )4 ]0 ), making the matching bracket unambiguous, whereas k k -Shuffle Dyck leaves several candidates open (e.g., the first ‘ ) ’ above has two open ‘ ( ’ candidates).
blocks.zh:
kk-Shuffle Dyck(Hu et al.,2025)是互开式括号对上下文敏感的语言(如( ])).
作为报告向自然语言语法转移的基本PPT任务,它是我们的首要合成任务. MP-Struct Core(Mita等人,2026年)在每个括号(如[0H_C(4)4]0)旁边放置标记符号,使对应的括号明确无误,而kk-Shuffle Dyck留下了几名候选人(如上面的第一个`)'有两个空缺候选人。

blocks.en:
Set ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) removes duplicate tokens while preserving their original order (e.g., 1 2 2 | 1 2 ).
This requires tracking previously seen tokens, but no hierarchical recursion.
The neural cellular automata ( NCA ) task ( Lee et al., 2026 ) consists of successive states of an NCA, where a fixed rule updates each cell from its neighbors.
The resulting dependencies repeat over time and are not nested.
blocks.zh:
Set(Jiang et al., 2026)在保留其原始顺序的同时去除重复的符号(例如, 1 2 2 + 1-2 ).
这需要跟踪以前看到的符号,但不进行等级重复.
神经细胞自体(NCA)任务(Lee等人,2026年)由NCAA的连续状态组成,其中固定规则从邻居处更新每个细胞.
由此产生的依附关系随时间而重复,不筑巢.

blocks.en:
We introduce a natural-language control task ( Control ) where we sample sequences for 𝒟 PPT \mathcal{D}_{\text{PPT}} from 𝒟 PT \mathcal{D}_{\text{PT}} , disjoint from samples seen during PT.
This separates the effect of synthetic sequences from that of the extra optimization steps on performance.

我们引入一个自然语言控制任务( Control), 将 DPT\ mathcal{ D}_{\Text{ PPT} 从 DPT\mathcal{ D}_{\Text{ PT}}} 中取样序列, 与 PT 期间看到的样本脱节 。
这把合成序列与附加优化步骤对性能的影响区分开来.

blocks.en: 3.4 Model Scales
blocks.zh: 3.4 模型规模

blocks.en: To evaluate how model capacity interacts with PPT, we test four model scales: 500M, 1B, 3B, and 7B.
blocks.zh: 为了评价模型能力如何与PPT相互作用,我们测试了四个模型尺度:500M,1B,3B和7B.

blocks.en: 500M and 1B scales follow the setting of prior work in model size (§ 2.3 ), verifying reported PPT downstream performance and token-efficiency gains.
blocks.zh: 500M和1B比例尺遵循了模型尺寸(第2.3节)的先前工作的设定,核实所报告的PPT下游性能和象征性效率收益。

blocks.en:
3B crosses the model size in which Biderman et al. (2023) report a transition point, where LMs begin to acquire complex factual and structural capabilities that smaller models fail to learn under the same PT data regime.
Theoretical studies ( Merrill et al., 2021 ; Strobl et al., 2024 ) also show that large Transformers can learn hierarchical abstractions directly through standard gradient descent.
This setting therefore tests whether capacity alone makes PPT redundant.
blocks.zh:
3B跨越了Biderman等人的模型大小. (2023年)报告有一个过渡点,LMs开始获得复杂的事实和结构能力,而较小的模型在相同的PT数据制度下无法学习.
理论研究(Merrill et al., 2021;Strobl et al., 2024)也表明,大型变形器可以直接通过标准梯度递减来学习等级抽象.
因此,这种设置检验单凭能力是否使PPT变得多余.

blocks.en:
7B extends the model size beyond the ≤ \leq 1B setting of prior work and is widely used among open-weight releases ( Touvron et al., 2023 ; Qwen et al., 2025 ; IFM Team, 2026 ) .
This setting tests whether PPT helps as model capacity grows further. 3 3 3 Compute constraints limit 7B evaluations to the Marin mixture (up to 75.5B PT tokens) and k k -Shuffle Dyck.
blocks.zh:
7B将模型大小扩展至前作的\\leq 1B设置之外,并广泛用于开放重量释放(Touvron等人,2023年;Quen等人,2025年;IFM Team,2026年).
这种设定测试PPT是否有助于模型容量的进一步发展. 3 3 3 计算约束将7B评价限制在马林混合物(最多75.5B PT令牌)和k k-Shuffle Dyck.

blocks.en: 3.5 Pre-training Budget
blocks.zh: 3.5 培训前预算

blocks.en:
Prior PPT studies stop PT early, typically after roughly 2B tokens, and train with small batches ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) .
Under these conditions, reported gains may reflect a short-lived initialization advantage or gradient noise rather than a durable bias (§ 2.3 ).
We therefore adopt a two-tiered optimization budget.
blocks.zh:
先前的PPT研究很早就停止了PT,一般在大约2B符号后停止,并用小批量进行训练(Hu等人,2025年;Mita等人,2026年;Jiang等人,2026年;Guo等人,2026年)。
在这种情况下,所报告的增益可能反映短寿命初始化优势或梯度噪声,而不是持久的偏差(第2.3节)。
因此,我们采用两级优化预算。

blocks.en:
Our standard PT budget keeps the 10K-step horizon of Hu et al. (2025) but raises the batch size to 512 sequences (2.1M tokens per step) with a 4,096-token context window, yielding 21B tokens, following a recent approach for effective PT with synthetic data ( Niklaus et al., 2026 ) .
This expansion increases token exposure during training by 12.8 to 25.6 × \times over prior work ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ) .
This setup tests whether the PPT benefits persist under large-batch, low-noise optimization with long-context dependencies.
blocks.zh:
我们的PT标准预算保持了Hu等人的10K步平面(2025年),但将批量大小提升到512个序列(每步2.1M个令牌),并设有4,096个托肯上下文窗口,产生21B个令牌,遵循了最近用合成数据有效PT的方法(Niklaus等人,2026年).
这一扩展使培训期间的象征性接触增加了12.8至25.6×次,超过了以前的工作(Hu等人,2025年;Mita等人,2026年)。
这个设置测试PPT的好处是否在大批量,低噪声的优化下继续存在,具有长的关联性.

blocks.en:
Our extended PT budget reaches 100B tokens (47,684 steps) at 3B, roughly 33 tokens per parameter, which exceeds compute-optimal allocations for multi-billion parameter models ( Hoffmann et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) and matches foundation model recipe ablations ( Bakouch et al., 2025 ; Team Olmo et al., 2026 ) .
This tests whether the benefit of PPT persists or dilutes over prolonged training.
blocks.zh:
我们扩展的PT预算达到100B令牌(47,684步),达到3B,每个参数约33个令牌,超过数十亿参数模型的计算-优化分配(Hoffmann等人,2022年;Chen等人,2025年),并匹配基础模型配方(Bakouch等人,2025年;Team Olmo等人,2026年)。
这种检验是PPT的好处继续存在,还是因长期培训而减弱。

blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Model Training
blocks.zh: 4.1 示范培训

blocks.en:
All models use the SmolLM3 architecture and tokenizer ( Bakouch et al., 2025 ) with a 128,256-token vocabulary.
We vary only width, depth, and head counts and keep the optimizer, learning rate schedule, batch size, context window, and precision identical (Appendix Table 6 ).
At 7B, we lower the learning rate for training stability while keeping the same schedule.
Performance differences across scales therefore primarily reflect the influence of model capacity.

在7B时,我们降低训练稳定性的学习率,同时保持同样的进度。
因此,不同比额表的业绩差异主要反映了模型能力的影响。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价

blocks.en: We compare each PPT configuration against two baselines at the same scale and PT data mixture. PT-Only ( θ PT \theta_{\text{PT}} ) trains from a random initialization with no preliminary phase ( θ 0 \theta_{0} ), measuring the net effect of PPT. Control (§ 3.2 ) serves as a second baseline, as it runs the identical 500-step phase on held-out text from 𝒟 PT \mathcal{D}_{\text{PT}} .

blocks.en:
We also examine whether the explanation for the effectiveness of PPT proposed by Hu et al. (2025) , a grammatical prior evidenced by grammatical acceptability, holds under our expanded scale and PT budgets.
We adopt the same two benchmarks:
(1) BLiMP ( Warstadt et al., 2020 ) measures zero-shot grammatical acceptability over 12 paradigm groups, reporting overall mean accuracy alongside subgroup scores for semantics, morphology, and syntax.
(2) Verbatim retrieval ( Armeni et al., 2022 ; Armeni et al., 2024 ) cues a model to repeat a noun list seen earlier in context, reporting mean NLL over the full stimulus, where lower values indicate more reliable retrieval.
blocks.zh:
我们还研究了胡等人提出的PPT有效性解释. (2025年),一种以语法可接受性为证明的前语法,在我们扩大的规模和PT预算下持有.
我们采用同样的两个基准:
(1)BLIMP(Warstadt等人,2020年)在12个范式组中测量零射程语法可接受性,报告整体平均精度与语义,形态学,语法的分组分数并列.
(2) 逐字记录检索(Armeni等人,2022年;Armeni等人,2024年)提示一种模式,重复前文中看到的名词清单,报告是指NLL在全部刺激中,数值较低表明检索更加可靠。

blocks.en:
We evaluate each run every 1K steps and report the mean and standard deviation (SD) over the second half of training (i.e., 5K to 10K steps).
We call a PPT gain stable when its mean exceeds its SD across these checkpoints.
Downstream conclusions remain invariant to window selection (Appendix B.1 ).
Each configuration is a single run, except for PT-Only and k k -Shuffle Dyck at 3B on Marin, which we repeat with three random seeds (Appendix B.2 ).
Appendix A.3 gives further evaluation details.

我们称PPT越过这些检查站,其平均值超过其SD,则PPT得到稳定.
下游结论对于窗口选择仍然不尽相同(附录B.1 ).
每个配置都是单跑,除了PT-Only和k-Shuffle Dyck at 3B on Marin,我们用三个随机种子(附录B.2)重复.
附录A.3提供了进一步的评价细节。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 General Capability
blocks.zh: 5.1 一般能力

blocks.en:
Figure 2 shows the change in downstream performance from PPT relative to PT-Only. k k -Shuffle Dyck improves downstream performance in most scale-mixture pairs.
Of the 12 pairs (4 PT data mixtures × \times 3 model scales), 9 gain at least 0.6 points on the downstream average, with a mean gain of 1.6 among them.
The gain is also similar across scales (0.8 at 500M, 1.4 at 1B, 1.3 at 3B).
The effectiveness of PPT thus does not diminish as model capacity grows.
The remaining three pairs gain little or lose (C4 at 500M + + 0.3, OLMo3 at 1B − - 0.5, OLMo3 at 3B + + 0.0), which leaves OLMo3 as the only PT mixture that fails to benefit at more than one scale.
We examine its data composition in § 6 .
blocks.zh:
图2显示与PT-Only相比下游性能的变化. kk-Shuffle Dyck在大多数比例混合配对中提高了下游的性能.
在12对中(4 PT 数据混合物 ×\times 3模型尺度),9在下游平均值上至少获得0.6分,其中平均收益为1.6分.
不同尺度的增益也相似(500M时0.8,1B时1.4,3B时1.3).
因此,随着模型能力的增强,预防酷刑的有效性不会减弱。
其余三对的增益甚微或亏损(C4在500M++0.3,OLMo3在1B−−−0.5,OLMo3在3B++0.0),这使得OLMo3成为唯一未能在一个以上尺度上受益的PT混合物.
我们在第6节中审查了其数据构成。

Full scores are in Appendix Table 7 .

酒吧显示5K-10K检查站的对数差异; 胡子表示±\pm 1 SD。

blocks.en:
The Control results indicate that the gains stem from the synthetic PPT data rather than from the additional optimization steps.
Control, which runs the same 500 warm-up steps on held-out PT text, stays close to PT-Only at every scale, with mean differences of − - 0.2 at 500M, + + 0.4 at 1B, and + + 0.2 at 3B.
In contrast, k k -Shuffle Dyck outperforms Control in 10 of the 12 pairs, by mean margins of 1.0, 1.0, and 1.1 points at the three scales.
blocks.zh:
控制结果表明,收益来自合成的PPT数据,而不是额外的优化步骤。
Control,在持有的PT文本上运行同样的500个热量步骤,在每个尺度上都保持接近PT-Only,平均差值为− -0.2在500M,+++0.4在1B,++0.2在3B.
相比之下,k k-Shuffle Dyck在12对中的10对中超过了控制,其平均比值为1.0,1.0,在3对比分中为1.1分.

blocks.en:
We observe that the downstream gains are also broad across task types.
Each category improves in 9 or more of the 12 scale-mixture pairs in Figure 2 (RC 11, Science QA 10, CR 9, and LM 10).
In particular, language modeling gains the most at all three scales (1.2, 1.8, and 1.7 points, against 0.3 to 1.3 for the remaining categories).
At the benchmark level, ReCoRD and HellaSwag improve in all 12 pairs and LAMBADA in 10 (Appendix Table 7 ).
All three require information from the preceding passage, since their answers are often not determined by the candidate sentence alone.
We return to this shared requirement in § 5.2 .
blocks.zh:
我们注意到,下游的收益也广泛涉及各类任务。
在图2(RC 11、Science QA 10、CR 9和LM 10)的12个尺度混合对中,每个类别有9个或更多改进。
特别是,在所有三个比额表中,语文建模最多(1.2、1.8和1.7分,其余类别为0.3至1.3分)。
在基准水平上,ReCORD和HelaSwag在所有12对和LAMBADA中都有改善(附录表7 )。
这三个国家都需要上一段提供的信息,因为它们的答复往往不是仅由候选判决决定的。
我们回到第5.2条的这一共同要求。

blocks.en: Takeaway Synthetic PPT yields a downstream gain that holds across model scales and PT mixtures for a small fraction of the training cost.
blocks.zh: 外卖合成器 PPT产生下游收益,在模型尺度和PT混合物之间占培训费用的一小部分。

blocks.en: 5.2 Linguistic Competence
blocks.zh: 5.2 语言能力

blocks.en:
Table 2: Verbatim retrieval as mean NLL ( ↓ \downarrow ) averaged over checkpoints at 5K–10K steps ( Δ \Delta = PPT − - PT-Only).
Subscripts are standard deviations (SD) across checkpoints. Green marks an improvement over the baseline.

下标是跨越检查站的标准差(SD). 绿色标志着比基线有所改善。

blocks.en:
We now test whether the downstream gains from PPT stem from the grammatical prior proposed by Hu et al. (2025) .
If they do, PPT should also improve grammatical acceptability on BLiMP.
Figure 3 shows the BLiMP accuracy delta induced by PPT relative to PT-Only.
Although k k -Shuffle Dyck improves overall accuracy in 9 of the 12 scale-mixture pairs, only one of these gains is stable (OLMo3 at 1B), against 10 of 12 for the downstream average (Appendix Table 9 ).
This outcome does not align with prior work, which reports gains in grammatical acceptability from formal language PPT ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Mita et al., 2026 ) .
Even at 500M, a scale within the range of prior work, we observe mixed results.
Two mixtures improve (OLMo3 + + 0.6, Marin + + 0.3), while two degrade (SmolLM3 − - 0.3, C4 − - 0.6).
The largest degradation is on C4, on which Hu et al. (2025) report gains.
Looking at the results by model scale, we find that larger models do not resolve the disagreement either.
On Marin, the overall delta moves from + + 0.3 at 500M to + + 1.6 at 1B and back to − - 0.3 at 3B.
blocks.zh:
我们现在测试PPT的下游收益是否来自胡等人先前提出的语法(2025年).
如果有,PPT也应提高BLIMP的语法可接受性.
图3显示了PPT相对于PT-Only诱导的BLIMP精度三角洲.
虽然kk-Shuffle Dyck在12个比例混合对中的9个提高了总体准确度,但这些增益中只有一个是稳定的(OLMo3 at 1B),而下游平均值为12个中的10个(附录表9)。
这一结果与以前的工作不一致,以前的工作报告说,正式语言PPT在语法上的可接受性有所提高(Hu等人,2025年;Mita等人,2026年)。
即使在500海里,也就是以前工作范围内的尺度,我们发现结果好坏参半。
两种混合物有所改进(OLMo3 + + 0.6,Marin + + 0.3),两种降解(SmolLM3 − - 0.3,C4 − - 0.6)。
最大的降解是在C4上,Hu等人对此进行了降解. (2025)报告成果。
从模型尺度来看结果,我们发现,更大的模型也不能解决分歧。
在马林岛上,整体三角洲从++0.3在500M到++1.6在1B,回到−-0.3在3B.

Figure 3: BLiMP score changes from PPT relative to PT-Only.
Bars show mean paired differences across 5K–10K checkpoints; whiskers denote ± \pm 1 SD.
Full scores are in Appendix Table 8 .

图3:BLIMP的分数与PT-Only相比有所变化.
酒吧显示5K-10K检查站的对数差异; 胡子表示±\pm 1 SD。

blocks.en:
The subgroup breakdown does not change this picture.
If PPT imparts a grammatical prior, it should surface in Morphology and Syntax, which test hierarchical dependencies such as agreement and constituency.
These are the exact dependencies that k k -Shuffle Dyck, a hierarchical bracket-matching language, is hypothesized to transfer.
Yet neither subgroup shows a stable gain (Appendix Table 8 ).
blocks.zh:
分组分解不会改变这一画面。
如果PPT在语法上传递前一种语法,它应该在摩菲学和语法中浮出水面,从而检验等级依赖性如协议和选区.
这些是K-Shuffle Dyck,一种分级的括号匹配语言,被假定为可以转移的精确的依赖关系 。
然而,两个分组都没有显示稳定的收益(附录表8)。

blocks.en:
Verbatim retrieval, the second benchmark of Hu et al. (2025) , shows a different pattern (Table 2 ). k k -Shuffle Dyck lowers NLL in all 12 scale-mixture pairs, with a stable reduction in 7 of them against 1 of 12 for BLiMP.
Control, by contrast, improves in 8 but only 3 of these reductions are stable.
blocks.zh:
平面检索是Hu等人(2025年)的第二个基准,显示不同的模式(表2)。 kk-Shuffle Dyck 在所有12个比例混合对中降低NLL,其中7个相对BLIMP的12个中1个稳定减少.
相比之下,8项控制措施有所改善,但其中只有3项是稳定的。

blocks.en:
We attribute this gap to the divergent demands of the two evaluations.
BLiMP compares two sentences that differ in one grammatical feature, where the deciding evidence lies within the sentence.
Verbatim retrieval instead requires locating a span earlier in a long context and copying it. k k -Shuffle Dyck requires an analogous operation over an abstract vocabulary, matching each closing bracket to its opening bracket across an arbitrary number of intervening symbols.
This suggests that PPT induces a long-range retrieval capability rather than the grammatical prior proposed by Hu et al. (2025) .
It also explains why downstream gains are largest on LAMBADA, ReCoRD, and HellaSwag (§ 5.1 ), as all three require information from the preceding passage to determine an answer.
blocks.zh:
我们将此差距归因于两项评价的不同要求。
BLIMP比较一个语法特征中两个不同的句子,其中决定证据位于句子内.
反之,逐字记录检索需要更早地在长的上下文中找到并复制。 kk-Shuffle Dyck 需要一个在抽象词汇之上的类似操作,在任意数量的干涉符号上将每个关闭括号与开括号相匹配。
这表明PPT诱导长程检索能力,而不是胡等人先前提出的语法(2025年).
这也解释了为什么LAMBADA、ReCORD和HelaSwag(第5.1节)的下游收益最大,因为这三个项目都需要上一段提供的信息来确定答案。

blocks.en: Takeaway PPT improves long-range retrieval more reliably than grammatical acceptability, and its downstream gains, while broad, are largest on tasks that depend on the preceding context.
blocks.zh: Takeaway PPT比语法上的可接受性更可靠地改进了远程检索,其下游的收益虽然广泛,但最大的取决于取决于前一种上下文的任务.

blocks.en: 6 Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 分析

blocks.en:
Table 3: Ablations at 3B: (a) Marin composition and (b) PPT task.
Scores are mean paired differences from PT-Only over checkpoints at 5K–10K steps.
In (a), subscripts are standard deviations across checkpoints.
In (b), scores are averaged over the four mixtures, except for PT-Only, which gives absolute scores, and n / 4 n/4 counts the mixtures in which the downstream average improves (per-mixture breakdown in Appendix Table 14 ). Green marks an improvement.
blocks.zh:
表3:3B的缺损:(a)马林成分和(b)PPT任务。
积分是PT-只在5K-10K台阶的检查站上与PT-的正对差异.
在(a)项中,下标是跨越检查站的标准偏差。
在(b)中,除PT-Only给出绝对分数外,对四种混合物的分数均值,n / 4 n/4计算下游平均值改善的混合物(附录表14按混合物分列)。 绿色标志一个进步。

blocks.en:
Modern PT mixtures allocate a large share to code and mathematics, whose nested dependencies may already supply the structural signal that PPT provides (§ 3.3 ).
If this holds, PPT should become redundant as code and mathematics content grows.
We test this on Marin, the mixture with the largest gains at 3B (§ 5.1 ; Figure 2 ), by varying its PT composition (Table 3 a). 4 4 4 17% Math raises the math share from 1.3% to 17.0% at the expense of DCLM, leaving code unchanged at 6.1%. DCLM only keeps the web component alone, FineWeb-Edu only replaces it with the educational web corpus FineWeb-Edu, and Marin\DCLM removes DCLM and renormalizes the remaining code and math. Raising the mathematics share from 1.3% to 17.0% lowers the web share from 92.6% to 76.9%, matching OLMo3 (Table 1 ).
This results in an average gain of 2.0 points against 1.9 for the Marin full PT mixture, with the per-category deltas almost unchanged.
Therefore, a 13 × \times increase in mathematical content does not diminish the benefits of PPT.
blocks.zh:
现代PT混合物为代码和数学分配了很大份额,其巢系依赖关系可能已经提供了PPT提供的结构信号(§3.3.
如果这样坚持,PPT应该随着代码和数学内容的增长而变得多余.
我们在Marin测试这一点,该混合物在3B(§ 5.1;图2)中收益最大,通过改变其PT组成(表3a)进行测试。 4 4 4 17%的数学将数学份额从1.3%提高到17.0%,而DCLM则牺牲了这个比例,使代码不变,为6.1%。 DCLM只保留网页组件,FineWeb-Edu只将其替换为教育性网页集FineWeb-Edu,Marin\DCLM删除DCLM,并重新规范剩余代码和数学. 将数学份额从1.3%提高到17.0%,将网络份额从92.6%降至76.9%,与OLMo3(表1)相匹配。
这导致马林全PT混合物的平均增益为2.0分,比1.9分,每类三角体几乎不变.
因此,数学内容的13×\时的增加并不减少PPT的好处.

blocks.en:
By contrast, we find that web text is essential.
DCLM alone retains 1.5 of the 1.9 points on average and FineWeb-Edu retains 1.0.
Removing web text entirely (Marin\DCLM in Table 3 a), which leaves 82% source code and 18% mathematics, reduces the average PPT gain to 0.2 points.
Language modeling follows the same pattern, gaining 1.5 to 3.1 points wherever web text is present and 0.6 without it.
Verbatim retrieval improves for all five PT data variants, and the improvement is stable in three of them (Marin full, 17% Math, and DCLM only).
BLiMP echoes the pattern of § 5.2 , in that the performance deltas remain small and none is stable.
The benefit of PPT thus holds across the diverse range of content that current PT mixtures occupy and disappears only under a web-free condition that no practical mixture approaches.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,我们认为网络文本至关重要。
仅DCLM就平均保留1.9分中的1.5分,FineWeb-Edu保留1.0.
完全删除网页文本(表3 a中的Marin\DCLM),它留下了82%的源代码和18%的数学,将平均PPT增益降至0.2分.
语言建模遵循相同的模式,在网络文本存在的地方,可以获得1.5至3.1分,没有网络文本则获得0.6分.
所有五个PT数据变体的逐字记录检索都有改进,其中三个(Marin full,17% Math,仅DCLM)的改进是稳定的.
BLIMP呼应了第5.2节的规律,即性能三角洲仍然很小,无一是稳定的.
因此,PPT的好处存在于目前PT混合物所占据和消失的各种内容中,只有在不采用实际混合物的无网络条件下。

blocks.en:
Neither the math share nor the web share explains the weak PPT gains on OLMo3 (§ 5.1 ).
The 17% Math variant matches the 76.9% web share of OLMo3 yet retains an average gain of 2.0 points.
Likewise, SmolLM3 differs from OLMo3 by only three points in web share, yet its PPT gain at 3B is 1.8 points against 0.0 for OLMo3 (Appendix Table 14 ; k k -Shuffle Dyck).
We leave a direct ablation of OLMo3, and the property responsible for this gap, for future work. 5 5 5 The 3B experiments reported here already consume approximately 1.07T PT tokens, which places further runs beyond our computing capacity.
blocks.zh:
数学共享和网络共享都无法解释OLMo3(§5.1)上的PPT增益弱.
17%的数学变体与OLMo3的76.9%的网络份额相匹配,但仍保留2.0分的平均收益.
同样,SmolLM3与OLMo3在网络份额上仅差3分,然而其PPT在3B的增益为1.8分,而OLMo3则为0.0(附录表14;kk-Shuffle Dyck).
我们为今后的工作留下了OLMo3的直接缩写,以及造成这一缺口的财产。 5 5 5 这里报道的3B实验已经消耗了大约1.07T PT的代币,这进一步超出了我们的计算能力.

blocks.en: Takeaway Code and mathematics do not make PPT redundant. Its gain holds across the compositions of current PT mixtures and requires only the presence of web text.
blocks.zh: 外卖代码和数学不会使PPT变得多余. 其收益贯穿当前PT混合物的成分,只需要网络文本的存在即可.

blocks.en:
To test whether the PPT benefit requires a formal grammar, we evaluate three further tasks at the 3B scale across all mixtures (Table 3 b): MP-Struct Core (formal), alongside NCA and Set (non-formal).
We first observe that the formal boundary does not separate the effective PPT tasks. MP-Struct Core ( + + 0.9 on average) and the non-formal NCA ( + + 1.2) yield gains comparable to k k -Shuffle Dyck ( + + 1.3), and all three improve 3 of the 4 mixtures.
blocks.zh:
为了检验PPT福利是否需要一种正式的语法,我们对所有混合物的3B尺度(表3b)评估另外三项任务:MP-Struct Core(正式),与NCAA和Set(非正式)并列。
我们首先观察到,正式边界并不区分有效的PPT任务. MP-Struct Core(平均++ 0.9)和非正规NCAA(+ + 1.2)的产值与k k-Shuffle Dyck(+ + 1.3)相当,所有三种均改进了4种混合物中的3种.

blocks.en:
In contrast, Set degrades downstream performance by 7.2 points and improves none.
The three effective tasks all require retrieving a specific earlier position in the sequence.
Specifically, k k -Shuffle Dyck matches a closing bracket to its opening bracket; MP-Struct Core anchors an explicit structural marker; and NCA reproduces the corresponding cell of the preceding automaton state.
Set only asks whether a token has appeared before.
The model can answer this by keeping a running record of seen tokens, without locating any specific earlier position.
This lack of positional retrieval may explain why Set performs poorly.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,Set使下游性能退化了7.2分,没有改善.
三项有效任务都要求检索序列中较早的具体位置。
具体来说,k k - Shuffle Dyck 将一个关闭括号与其开口括号匹配; MP-Struct Core 锚定一个明显的结构标记; NCAA 复制了前一个自动马顿状态的相应单元格.
只设定询问之前是否出现过一个符号 。
该模型可以通过保存所见信物的运行记录来回答这一点,而无需找到任何特定的早期位置.
缺乏位置检索可能说明Set为何表现不佳。

blocks.en:
This retrieval account is consistent with prior work, which already hints at dependency structure as the active property. Specifically, Hu et al. (2025) require an effective PPT language to capture hierarchical dependencies, and Mita et al. (2026) find that reducing retrieval ambiguity in those dependencies is what drives the gain.
Our results converge with prior work on which property of the task matters, and diverge on what the model acquires from it.
These results suggest that synthetic PPT aids general capability by inducing a long-range retrieval capability rather than a grammatical prior (§ 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
这个检索账户与先前的工作一致,它已经暗示依赖结构为活动属性. 具体来说,Hu等人(2025年)需要一种有效的PPT语言来捕捉等级依赖性,Mita等人(2026年)发现,减少这些依赖性中的检索模糊性是推动收益的因素.
我们的成果与先前关于任务财产重要性的工作趋同,并对模式从中获得什么有分歧。
这些结果表明,合成PPT通过诱导远程检索能力而不是语法前的检索能力(第5.2节)来辅助一般能力.

blocks.en: Takeaway Any PPT task that requires retrieving a specific earlier position is a safe choice, with k k -Shuffle Dyck and NCA giving comparable gains. In contrast, Set, which only requires tracking seen tokens, degrades performance.
blocks.zh: 外卖 任何需要检索先前特定位置的 PPT 任务都是安全选择,K k - Shuffle Dyck 和 NCAA 给予类似的收益. 相比之下,Set只要求跟踪所见的符号,会降低性能.

blocks.en:
Table 4: Scaling. Each entry is the difference between PPT ( k k -Shuffle Dyck) and the PT-Only baseline at the same PT budget. Score breakdowns are in Appendix Tables 15 and 16 .
Results at 21B tokens are not comparable to § 5 , as the two use different learning rate schedules.
blocks.zh:
表4: 缩放。 每个条目都是PPT(k k-Shuffle Dyck)和同一PT预算的PT-Only基线的区别. 分数细目载于附录表15和16。
21B令牌的结果与第5节不相上下,因为两者使用不同的学习率时间表。

blocks.en:
Our main experiments stop at 21B PT tokens and at most 3B parameters.
The PPT benefit may still disappear with longer training (§ 3.5 ), and larger models may not need it (§ 3.4 ).
We therefore extend the 3B PT runs to 100B tokens on C4 and Marin, and train a 7B model on Marin for 75.5B tokens.
Table 4 shows that the downstream benefit persists under both extensions.
The downstream average improves in all 14 budget points across the three extended runs, by 1.0 on average on C4, 1.3 on Marin, and 0.6 at 7B.
Although PPT gains fluctuate, they do not degrade at longer budgets, ending at + + 1.6 on C4 and + + 1.2 on Marin at 100B, against + + 1.2 and + + 1.1 at 21B.
On Marin, PPT reaches 62.3 on average after 63B tokens, whereas PT-Only reaches 62.0 after 84B (Appendix Table 15 ). This saves at least 21B PT tokens.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要实验停止在21B PT 符和最多3B参数.
随着培训时间的延长(第3.5节),PPT福利可能仍然会消失,较大的模式可能不需要(第3.4节)。
因此,我们扩展了C4和Marin上的3B PT运行到100B令牌,并在Marin上培训一个7B型号,用于75.5B令牌.
表4显示,下游福利在两个延长期内都继续存在。
在三个延长周期的所有14个预算点上,下游平均改善,C4、1.3和0.6平均改善。
虽然PPT增益波动,但不会在较长的预算中降解,在C4上以++1.6结束,在100B上以+++1.2结束,在21B上以+++1.1结束.
在马林岛,PPT在63B令牌后平均达到62.3,而PT-Only在84B后达到62.0(附录表15). 这至少可以保存21B PT 令牌.

blocks.en:
At 7B, the downstream gain narrows but persists.
On Marin, the average gain falls from 1.3 at 3B to 0.6 at 7B, yet it remains positive at every budget.
This narrowing may partly reflect budget rather than capacity.
The 7B runs reach roughly 11 tokens per parameter against 33 at 3B, and the largest 7B gain occurs at the longest budget ( + + 1.0 at 75.5B tokens).
As in § 5.2 , BLiMP gains remain mixed at both scales, improving in only 4 of the 14 budget points, whereas verbatim retrieval improves in 10.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We have presented the first systematic study of PPT at scale, spanning five PPT tasks, four PT data mixtures, four model scales (500M to 7B), and PT budgets of up to 100B tokens.
We first show that the downstream benefits of PPT persist under both parameter and PT budget scaling.
In contrast to previous work, we find that the attribution of these gains to a grammatical prior does not hold.
Specifically, downstream gains from PPT arise without equivalent gains in grammatical acceptability. We show instead that PPT is effective when the PPT task requires retrieving tokens from earlier positions in a sequence (§ 6 ; PPT Tasks).
Finally, we demonstrate that PPT gains are insensitive to the share of code and math in the PT corpus, and diminish only when web text is absent.
These findings suggest that future PPT tasks may benefit more from targeting long-range retrieval directly than from mimicking the hierarchical structure of natural language grammar.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了PPT的首次规模系统研究,涉及五个PPT任务,四个PT数据混合物,四个模型尺度(500M至7B),以及最多100B符号的PT预算.
我们首先表明,在参数和PT预算规模下,PPT的下游效益依然存在。
与以前的工作不同,我们发现,将这些收益归结为语法学前身并不存在.
具体来说,PPT产生的下游收益在语法可接受性方面没有相应的收益. 相反,当PPT任务需要从一个序列(§ 6;PPT任务)的先前位置检索符号时,我们显示PPT是有效的.
最后,我们表明,PPT收益对PTB程序中代码和数学的份额不敏感,只有在没有网络文本时才会减少。
这些调查结果表明,将来的PPT任务可能比模仿自然语言语法的等级结构更能从直接瞄准远程检索中受益.

blocks.en:
Our main experiments report single runs per configuration due to compute constraints.
For instance, the 3B PT experiments alone consume approximately 1.07T tokens, which precludes repeating every cell of the grid.
Nonetheless, we quantify seed sensitivity on the configuration our conclusions rely on most: Marin at 3B.
It yields the highest absolute scores for PT-Only and the largest 3B gain for k k -Shuffle Dyck.
We train two additional seeds per approach, giving three seeds each.
Each additional seed resamples the parameter initialization and the training data order while holding every architectural and optimization hyperparameter of Table 6 fixed, isolating stochastic variation from any change of setting.
blocks.zh:
由于计算的限制,我们的主要实验报告每个配置单次运行.
例如,光是3B PT实验就消耗了约1.07T个令牌,这就排除了电网每个细胞的重复.
尽管如此,我们在配置上量化种子敏感性,我们的结论主要依靠:Marin at 3B.
它为PT-Only的绝对分数最高,为k k-Shuffle Dyck的最大3B增益.
我们每个方法再训练两个种子,每个种子三个。
每一个额外的种子重新标注参数初始化和培训数据顺序,同时将表6的每个建筑和优化超参数固定,将结构变化与设置的变化隔离开来。

blocks.en:
Table 11 reports per-seed scores and the paired difference within each seed.
The PT-Only downstream average varies by 0.5 points across seeds (54.3, 54.0, and 54.5), and the gain from k k -Shuffle Dyck varies by 0.2 points ( + 1.9 +1.9 , + 1.9 +1.9 , and + 1.7 +1.7 ), which falls within the 0.5 checkpoint standard deviation reported for this configuration (Table 3 ).
Every downstream task category retains its sign in all three seeds, and HellaSwag and LAMBADA retain their large gains across seeds.
The downstream conclusion is therefore not an artifact of a single initialization.
blocks.zh:
表11报告每个种子的得分和每个种子的配对差异。
PT-仅下游平均值在不同的种子(54.3, 54.0和54.5)中相差0.5分,从kk-Shuffle Dyck得到的收益在0.2分(+1.9+1.9,+1.9+1.9,+1.7+1.7)之间相差0.5分,属于本配置报告的0.5检查站标准差(表3).
每个下游任务类别在所有三种种子中都保留其标志,HellaSwag和LAMBADA在种子中保留了它们的大收益.
因此,下游结论不是单一初始化的文物.

blocks.en:
The two linguistic competence benchmarks behave as § 5.2 predicts.
BLiMP overall (Table 12 ) moves from − 0.3 -0.3 to + 0.9 +0.9 across seeds, with a baseline spread of 1.6 points, reproducing within one configuration the sign instability we observe across mixtures and scales.
Verbatim retrieval (Table 13 ) improves in two of the three seeds, averaging − 0.033 -0.033 NLL, with the remaining seed at + 0.014 +0.014 .
The magnitude of this effect at a single configuration is thus comparable to checkpoint variance, and the retrieval account in § 6 rests on the stable verbatim gains across task-mixture pairs rather than on this configuration alone.
Seed variation therefore preserves the direction and magnitude of the PPT effect in this setting, which is consistent with the reduced gradient noise expected under large-batch optimization (§ 3.5 ).
blocks.zh:
两种语言能力基准是第5.2节预测的。
BLIMP总体(表12)从− 0.3-0.3到+0.9+0.9,跨种子,基线分布为1.6点,在一个布局内复制我们观察到的跨混合物和尺度的标志不稳定性。
平面检索(表13)在三个种子中有两个得到改进,平均−0.033-0.033 NLL,其余种子为+0.014+0.014.
因此,在单一配置中,这种影响的程度与检查站差异相当,第6款中的检索账户取决于任务组合对之间稳定的逐字记录收益,而不是仅依靠这种配置。
因此,种子变异保留了PPT效应在这个设置中的方向和规模,这与大批量优化下预期的梯度噪声减少一致(第3.5节).
